claims.claim_text: We expect approximately 172 attendees for this Guest Lecture, in line with turnout at our previous Guest Lecture events.
The requested budget of INR 22,000 is realistic and sufficient for this Guest Lecture.
Our previous events were delivered on budget and received excellent participant feedback.
This event complies with all applicable university policies and approval requirements.
